# 3 BHK New Builder Floor for Rent in Sector 23, Gurgaon

Discover comfortable and modern living with this beautifully designed **3 BHK New Builder Floor available for rent in Sector 23, Gurgaon**. Located in a prime residential neighbourhood, this property offers a perfect combination of comfort, convenience and a peaceful living environment.

The builder floor features spacious bedrooms, a well-designed living and dining area, modern bathrooms and a functional kitchen. With contemporary construction and quality fittings, it is an ideal choice for families looking for a premium rental home in Gurgaon.

**Key Features:**
- Newly Constructed Builder Floor
- Spacious 3 Bedrooms
- Modern Kitchen
- Well-designed Living & Dining Area
- Premium Quality Fittings
- Peaceful Residential Location
- Convenient Road Connectivity
- Close to Markets, Schools, Hospitals and Daily Essentials

**Location Advantages:**
Sector 23, Gurgaon offers excellent connectivity to Palam Vihar, Sector 22, Sector 21, NH-48, Dwarka Expressway and major commercial hubs.

**Ideal For:** Families & Bachlore looking for a new and comfortable home in Sector 23, Gurgaon.
